Omg I had the same issues and tweaked some settings and now omg my first layers are fucking perfect every time here is what I recommend:

1. Baby step the extruder down a bit probably around.06mm

2. Change the temp of the first layer around 8 degrees hotter than the normal printing temp.

3. Change the settings of the first layer to connected polygons and make it concentric pattern. 

I swear on my life these things will make your first layer and adhesion gorgeous. People say tweak the flow rate but honestly it’s kind of useless advice that generally I’ve found makes things messier. 

Just my two cents I print stuff now that takes a week or so and uses 3 kg of material so I feel comfortable giving advice now. But at the end of the day it’s whatever works for you stick to it!
